s: This article champions a robust, local-first approach to workflow automation, drawing inspiration from Unix pipes and the command-line interface for resilience against technological flux. It advocates for a self-contained, portable development environment built on core, stable technologies.
sub: Unix pipe-based automation for local workflows
Resilience against technological obsolescence via core tools (Linux, Python, vim, git)
Philosophical underpinnings of FOSS and self-reliance in tech
The power of the command-line interface (CLI) for automation
